title: StoryCard
description: Shape of each entry in data/story-cards.json's 'cards' array — 3-4 auto-generated 'state of hiring' stat cards built by build_story_cards() in scripts/build_data_readme.py from data/stats-history.json's own 'dimensions'. Every string is generated, not hand-written; every number traces back to a real snapshot count, and any week/month comparison is dropped rather than faked when there's no earlier dimensioned snapshot. The wrapper is { generated_at, cards }; only the cards[] entries are schema-checked.

id.description: Stable slug for this card slot (roles-total / internships / top-companies / geography / remote-share) — lets the client keep a stable React key and lets a test assert a specific card

detail.description: The one-line stat, e.g. '134 internships open · up 22% this month'

filter.description: A partial site FilterState the client applies (via handleQuickFilter) when the card is clicked — e.g. {"kind":"job","levels":["internship"]}. {} means 'just scroll to the list'. `kind` is a string; the multi-value facets (levels/regions/remotes/countries/tags) are string[]. Values mirror config/site-index.json's enums; nested types aren't checked by the dependency-free validator
